Execute a Multi-Stage SLURM Pipeline DAG

Source: R/pipeline.R
slurm_pipeline_run.Rd

Runs a validated slurm_pipeline() in topological order on any SlurmBackend.

  • On MockSlurmBackend (or any backend with wait = TRUE), each stage runs after its upstream dependencies satisfy dependency_type, collects upstream results cleanly, and forwards them to downstream stages via args_from_upstream or fan-in aggregation.

  • On SlurmSshBackend with wait = FALSE, stages are submitted directly to SLURM with genuine #SBATCH --dependency=afterok:<jobid1>:<jobid2> flags so the HPC scheduler enforces DAG ordering cluster-side.

Usage

slurm_pipeline_run(
  pipeline,
  backend,
  wait = TRUE,
  poll_interval = 0.08,
  timeout = Inf,
  auto_retry = 0L,
  stop_on_failure = TRUE,
  progress = FALSE
)

Arguments

pipeline

A slurmpilot_pipeline object from slurm_pipeline().

backend

A SlurmBackend object (MockSlurmBackend or SlurmSshBackend).

wait

Logical; wait for each stage to finish and pass results downstream (TRUE, default), or submit the full DAG asynchronously using SLURM --dependency flags (FALSE, supported for static-argument stages on SlurmSshBackend).

poll_interval

Polling interval in seconds passed to slurm_wait(). Default 0.08.

timeout

Per-stage timeout in seconds passed to slurm_wait(). Default Inf.

auto_retry

Non-negative integer adaptive retry rounds per stage when wait = TRUE. Default 0L.

stop_on_failure

Logical; when TRUE (default), skips downstream afterok stages if an upstream stage fails instead of aborting.

progress

Logical; emit stage progress messages via cli. Default FALSE.

Value

An S3 object of class "slurmpilot_pipeline_run" containing pipeline, backend, jobs, stage_states, results, dependencies_submitted, started_at, and finished_at.

See also

slurm_pipeline(), slurm_pipeline_status(), slurm_pipeline_collect()

Examples

s1 <- slurm_stage("sim", fun = function(x) x^2, args_list = as.list(1:4))
s2 <- slurm_stage("agg", fun = function(up) sum(up$sim), depends_on = "sim")
pipe <- slurm_pipeline(s1, s2, name = "two_stage")
be <- mock_slurm_backend(max_workers = 2L)
run <- slurm_pipeline_run(pipe, be, poll_interval = 0.05)
slurm_pipeline_collect(run)
#> [[1]]
#> [1] 30
#> 
unlink(be$root_dir, recursive = TRUE)
